$description: Lemma warm neutral and rose theme with balanced subject colours. Implementation pending owner review.

surface.track.$description: Visible progress tracks, busy blocks and loading placeholders.

surface.lifted.$description: Popover, child dialog and toast fill above a sheet.

state.lifted-hover.$description: Interaction fill inside a lifted surface.

border.default.$description: Visible non-text edges, at least 3:1 on adjacent surfaces

state.hover.$description: Pointer state overlay; never a subject or status.

state.pressed.$description: Pointer state overlay; never a subject or status.

viz.neutral.$description: Single-series amounts and meters that are not about a subject (never indigo, never a subject colour).

viz.easy.$description: The Easy grade in review charts and legends: a clear blue, distinct from Good (green), Hard (amber) and Again (red).

sans.$value: "Lemma v7 Instrument Sans", "Lemma v7 Sans fallback", sans-serif

serif.$value: "Lemma v7 Newsreader", "Lemma v7 Serif fallback", serif

subjectPalette.description: Each family has a distinct stroke. The shared OKLCH formula is the starting point. Strokes are adjusted for contrast and for separation under protanopia and deuteranopia. Tiles retain their low tint.

reservedHueRange.reason: Reserved for rose actions and red errors; never used for subjects.
